original_text: For models with an isotropic orbital structure, monotonicity of the density profile is a necessary, though not by itself sufficient, condition for consistency \citep{Binney2008, Ciotti2021}.
injected_text: Monotonicity of the density profile is a necessary, though not by itself sufficient, condition for consistency \citep{Binney2008, Ciotti2021}.
rationale: Binney2008 (and Ciotti2021) prove the monotonicity-necessity condition specifically for isotropic orbital structures; dropping the scope qualifier 'For models with an isotropic orbital structure' over-generalises the result to all dynamical models, directly contradicting both the cited sources and the very next sentence's caveat that for general anisotropic structures the problem is notoriously difficult.
ground_truth_description: Removed the explicit scope qualifier 'For models with an isotropic orbital structure,' so the necessity-of-monotonicity claim appears to apply to all orbital structures rather than only the isotropic case supported by the cited papers.

truth.claim_sentence_verbatim: For models with an isotropic orbital structure, monotonicity of the density profile is a necessary, though not by itself sufficient, condition for consistency \citep{Binney2008, Ciotti2021}.
